title: Police Blotter: 13 booked in Webb County — end-of-day roundup
excerpt: Thirteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Nov. 23, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges — family-violence assault, theft, criminal trespass and more. Every arrest is an allegation; each person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.
content:
Thirteen people were booked into the Webb County Jail on Monday, November 23, 2026, on alleged misdemeanor charges, according to Webb County booking records. Each person is listed below with the charge or hold shown in their booking record. An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction, and every person named here is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Efren Sanchez-Manriquez

Sanchez-Manriquez was arrested on Monday, November 23, 2026, at 4:26 a.m. on charges of criminal trespass of a habitation, shelter, superfund site or infrastructure site, a Class A misdemeanor, and harassment, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set on either charge at the time of booking. He was arrested by the Laredo Police Department.

Cesar Isaac Chavez

Chavez was arrested on Monday, November 23, 2026, at 4:59 a.m. on a charge of attempted burglary of a vehicle, a Class B misdemeanor. No bond had been set at the time of booking. The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.
